responsibility: Declares frontend-visible metadata structures and enums used by the Arm builtin implementation. It defines resolver identifiers for overloaded CDE builtins, the generated enumeration of AdvSIMD builtin type kinds, the bitmask-based qualifier scheme used to describe builtin argument and result types, and the arm_simd_type_info table layout that maps internal builtin type names to trees, element types, machine modes, and qualifiers.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declaration and metadata header for Arm builtins, defining resolver IDs, SIMD type and qualifier enums, and arm_simd_type_info, whereas arm-builtins.cc uses those definitions to register and expand the builtins.
